top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Gain on Tech, Oil Rises After Attacks: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks rose after US technology shares advanced on Friday. Oil climbed after the US and Iran traded tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Bathla Seeks Stopgap Funds as $2.5 Billion Debt Crisis Escalates
top_signals.summary: Bathla Group, the insolvent Australian property developer that’s shaken the nation’s real estate and private credit market, faces new tests at the start of the week.

top_signals.title: No bailout for Jaguar Land Rover, says business secretary
top_signals.summary: Business secretary Jonathan Reynolds has said the government will not bail out Jaguar Land Rover after it announced plans to slash 4,000 jobs.
